title: Exercise 1. Fix the broken node
html:
This build_node() should publish True on /scan_seen for every scan it receives. Assume rclpy, Bool and LaserScan are already imported and the lab's main() calls build_node(). It has three mistakes. Find and fix them.

def build_node():
    node = rclpy.create_node('scan_seen')
    publisher = node.create_publisher(Bool, '/scan_seen', 10)

    def handle_scan(scan):
        return Bool(data=True)

    node.create_subscription(LaserScan, '/scan', handle_scan(), 10)
